extracted.intended_audience: neuroscience researchers seeking McKnight Endowment Fund awards (early-career and translational investigators)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for researchers preparing applications to the McKnight Endowment Fund for Neuroscience's two competitive awards: the Neurobiology of Brain Disorders Award (translational investigators) and the Scholar Awards (early-stage independent investigators focused on learning and memory).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Bring science closer to the day when diseases of the brain and behavior can be accurately diagnosed, prevented, and treated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Fund prioritizes work that advances toward accurate diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of brain and behavioral diseases; program context cites impairments such as Alzheimer’s disease, Parkinson’s disease, multiple sclerosis, spinal cord injuries, and many others as areas advanced by supported research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for innovative research promising translational impact
rubrics_metrics.description: The Endowment Fund for Neuroscience ... supports innovative research through two competitive annual awards that seek out investigators whose research shows promise in bringing society closer to preventing, treating, and curing many devastating diseases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on innovation and clear promise of moving basic discoveries toward societal benefit (prevention, treatment, cure). Applicants should demonstrate how their work brings research closer to clinical or societal impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusivity and diversity in selection
rubrics_metrics.description: We promote excellence by increasing the inclusivity of our selection of awardees, acknowledging that the best science comes from embracing a diversity of opinions and perspectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection practices value diverse perspectives and inclusivity as part of scientific excellence; applicants and selection committees should consider representation and variety of viewpoints as a component of excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Neurobiology of Brain Disorders Award — translational focus
rubrics_metrics.description: For scientists translating laboratory discoveries about the brain and nervous system into diagnoses and therapies to improve human health.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended for investigators whose work is explicitly translational — moving laboratory findings toward diagnostic tools or therapeutic interventions with clear potential to improve human health.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scholar Awards — early-stage independent investigators focusing on learning and memory
rubrics_metrics.description: For scientists in the early stages of setting up independent laboratories and beginning to focus on disorders of learning and memory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeted to early-career scientists who are establishing independent labs and who are starting to direct their research toward learning-and-memory disorders; applications should reflect career-stage-appropriate plans and focus area alignment.
